risks.risk: Wrong engine variant (different Volkswagen 2.0 codes/years) leading to mismatch with mounts, sensors, wiring, or ECU
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate (often on the engine block) and/or the stamped engine code, plus the VIN/engine code from the donor car if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: incompatible/needs parts, so treated like a non-guaranteed fit.

risks.risk: Not working / incomplete assembly (missing sensors, alternator, starter, ECU, wiring harness, or key components)
risks.proof: Video of a cold start (or at least a running test) OR a checklist photo showing all major components included (starter, alternator, sensors, intake manifold, wiring/ECU if claimed).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: not working and/or incomplete.

risks.risk: Damage during removal/transport (cracked housings, bent shafts, broken mounts, coolant/oil leaks)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of critical areas: timing cover area, oil pan, cylinder head surface, mounting points, and any visible cracks/repairs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: may have hidden damage.

risks.risk: Mileage/usage condition unknown (wear level affects value)
risks.proof: Proof of mileage from donor paperwork or a photo of the odometer/VIN plate from the donor vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: unknown high wear.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the engine code/ID plate stamped on the engine block (and any part number stickers).
Send photos showing all included major components (starter, alternator, intake manifold, sensors, wiring/ECU if applicable) laid out or clearly visible.
Provide a running test video (or donor start video) and confirm whether it comes with ECU/wiring harness.
Send close-ups of mounting points and any visible cracks/repairs (oil pan, timing cover area, cylinder head area).
